def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    offsets=[(-1,1),(0,0),(1,-1),(1,0),(1,1)]

            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=4
    return out
